name: Bharti Airtel
tagline: Structurally improving telecom major with rising ARPU and falling leverage - a solid large-cap holding, but at ~Rs 11.7 lakh Cr there is no 10x/2-3yr or 100x/10yr path
business_overview: Bharti Airtel is India's second-largest telecom operator (mobile, home broadband, enterprise, digital TV) with a large Africa business and a data-centre arm (Nxtra). The thesis has been steady ARPU improvement, tariff repair, market-share gains from a weakened Vodafone Idea, and de-leveraging.
fundamentals_table: FY26 ~+17.1%; EBITDA ~+22.9%; Q3 FY26 consolidated revenue +19.6% YoY
Net debt / EBITDAaL improved to ~1.02x from ~1.98x
fundamentals_narrative: Genuinely improving fundamentals - ARPU up, EBITDA margins expanding, leverage roughly halved year on year, strong free cash generation. But it is a ~Rs 11.7 lakh crore mega-cap; the project's return bar is not reachable from here.
technical_read: Not independently pulled. Near all-time highs; market cap roughly flat over the trailing year despite earnings growth.
